name: Zen Geometric Credit
description: Price momentum confirmed by geometric option volume and return volatility.
limitations: Gross 3-year historical simulation (4 Oct 2023 - 30 Sep 2026, fixed INR 320,000). The formula was chosen on Jul 2025 - Oct 2026 data, so only Oct 2023 - Jun 2025 is out of sample. Missing option quotes (positions settled at the official NSE close when legs left the archive), estimated margin and excluded costs make results provisional; costs weigh more here because it trades about 160-220 times a year. Not a recovered Zen Credit replica.

rules.label: Price alpha
rules.description: 5-minute price change, ranked over 800 observed candles.

rules.label: Volume confirmation
rules.description: Geometric mean of ATM call and put volume ratios; 10-candle baseline.

rules.label: Volatility scaling
rules.description: Sum of call and put return standard deviations over 150 candles. Volume and volatility lag 5 candles; alpha2 ranks over 300.

rules.label: Bullish
rules.description: Both ranks > 0.8: sell ATM put, buy put 400 points lower.

rules.label: Bearish
rules.description: Both ranks < 0.2: sell ATM call, buy call 400 points higher.

rules.label: Entry window
rules.description: 10:15–14:15 IST. Positive spread credit; short premium ≤200.

rules.label: Risk & holding
rules.description: 5% estimated margin stop. 10-point spread target. Next-session exit, capped at expiry. Position sizing uses estimated margin.

name: Ratio-Fluxer Skew Credit
description: Expiry credit spreads that sell the relatively rich side of the 100-point NIFTY IV skew (spot-based Black-Scholes IV, session-local EMA-10, 800-minute rank), hedged 400 points away; put spreads only while the 20-session realised volatility is at most 16%; the 50% credit target applies on the entry day only, then the position runs to the 14:57 expiry-day exit or the stop.
exit_policy: 50% of entry credit target on the entry day only, 5% margin stop, 14:57 exit on expiry day
limitations: Gross historical simulation on Dhan minute closes, 4 Oct 2023 to 30 Sep 2026; missing option quotes, estimated margin and excluded costs make results provisional. The gate and put filter were tuned on 19 published Ratio-Fluxer trades from Oct 2025 to Sep 2026 (14 of 18 reproduced on the same day and side, 2 extra trades), so only Oct 2023 to Sep 2025 is out of sample: 53 trades, 47% winners, 28 stops, against 16 winners and no stops in the fitted year. The provider's private trigger is not recovered.
rules: Nearest weekly NIFTY expiry; entries 10:15-14:15 IST, never on expiry day, at most five days to expiry.
Skew = own Black-Scholes IV of the 100-point OTM put minus the 100-point OTM call (spot underlying, 6.5% rate), smoothed with a session-local exponential mean of span 10.

Credit CALL spread when the smoothed skew <= -3.0 IV points and its 800-minute rank is below 0.2; credit PUT spread when it is >= 4.5, the rank is above 0.8 and the annualised realised volatility of the last 20 daily index returns is at most 16%. No entries in weekend special sessions.
Sell the ATM strike of the last completed candle's open; buy 400 points further OTM; same expiry.
Target: spread value at 50% of entry credit, on the entry day only. Stop: entry credit plus 5% of normal margin per lot. Scheduled exit 14:57 IST on expiry day.
Sizing: floor(allocation / estimated margin); 80% of capital on Mondays from 6 April 2026, else 100%.
One position at a time; one evaluation per completed minute; no same-minute re-entry.

name: Ratio-Fluxer Afternoon Credit
description: The Ratio-Fluxer skew signal (R3) traded only in the afternoon, with a stop that waits an hour: expiry credit spreads on the rich side of the 100-point NIFTY IV skew, hedged 400 points away, entered from 11:45, with a 40% entry-day credit target and a credit + 50 stop active from 60 minutes after entry (a credit + 100 disaster stop is always on).
exit_policy: 40% of entry credit target on the entry day only; stop at credit + 50 from 60 minutes after entry, credit + 100 at any time; 14:57 exit on expiry day
limitations: Gross historical simulation on Dhan minute closes, 4 Oct 2023 to 30 Sep 2026; missing option quotes, estimated margin and excluded costs make results provisional. The signal is R3's (fitted on Oct 2025 to Sep 2026); the entry start, stop, grace period and target were chosen on all three years from about 1,500 variants, keeping only rules that improved each year and behaved alike at neighbouring settings. The improvement over R3 (drawdown -10.1% against -22.9%) is therefore in sample until forward paper trading confirms it.
rules: Nearest weekly NIFTY expiry; entries 11:45-14:15 IST, never on expiry day, at most five days to expiry.
Skew = own Black-Scholes IV of the 100-point OTM put minus the 100-point OTM call (spot underlying, 6.5% rate), smoothed with a session-local exponential mean of span 10.

Credit CALL spread when the smoothed skew <= -3.0 IV points and its 800-minute rank is below 0.2; credit PUT spread when it is >= 4.5, the rank is above 0.8 and the annualised realised volatility of the last 20 daily index returns is at most 16%. No entries in weekend special sessions.
Sell the ATM strike of the last completed candle's open; buy 400 points further OTM; same expiry.

Target: spread value at 60% of entry credit (40% of the credit captured), on the entry day only. Stop: entry credit plus 50 points (5.56% of normal margin per lot), checked from 60 minutes after entry; a disaster stop at credit plus 100 applies from entry. Scheduled exit 14:57 IST on expiry day.
Sizing: floor(allocation / estimated margin); 80% of capital on Mondays from 6 April 2026, else 100%.
One position at a time; one evaluation per completed minute; no same-minute re-entry.
